name: Level 1: Simple Web Application
description: A classic 2-tier architecture with a monolithic app server and a single PostgreSQL database.

metadata.inspiredBy: Standard beginner web development setup (Django, Rails, Node/Express with Postgres).
metadata.disclaimer: Great for up to ~1,000 active users. Beyond that, the single database and server saturate quickly.

metadata.description: Incoming client HTTP traffic from web browsers and mobile apps.
A single Node.js/Django compute instance handling both routing, business logic, and DB queries.
Single relational database on disk with no caching layer and no read-replicas.
